title: Madhya-khanda, part 14 (portion 37)
html:
The section "Mother Shachi's Grief" (end): Dhruva's austerities in Madhuvana and his testing by the gods; Narada with Krishna in Vaikuntha; Krishna grants Dhruva the highest place; Dhruva's return and reign; Shachi wishes to go with her son as a yogini; the Lord instructs His mother, shows her the form of Krishna and promises to come whenever she calls

Raga sindhura; disha: "Hari, O great one! I shall take refuge at Govinda's feet: the great sweetness of those crimson feet I have only now come to know."1

মধুবন দেখি' ধ্রুবের আনন্দ বাড়িল ।
তীর্থ-উপবাস করি' রজনী বঞ্চিল ॥ ৯৪ ॥

madhubana dekhi' dhrubera ānanda bāṛila |
tīrtha-upabāsa kari' rajanī bañcila || 94 ||

madhubana dekhi — seeing Madhuvana; dhruvera ananda badila — Dhruva's joy grew; tirtha-upavasa kari — keeping the pilgrim's fast; rajani vanchila — he spent the night

94Seeing Madhuvana, Dhruva was filled with joy;
keeping the pilgrim's fast, he spent the night [there].

প্রাতঃস্নান করি' ধ্রুব মন্ত্রজপ করে ।
না পাইল ক্ষুধা-তৃষ্ণা, ভাসে অশ্রুজলে ॥ ৯৫ ॥

prātaḥsnāna kari' dhruba mantrajapa kare |
nā pāila kṣudhā-tṛṣṇā, bhāse aśrujale || 95 ||

pratah-snana kari — bathing at dawn; dhruva mantra-japa kare — Dhruva repeats the mantra; na paila kshudha-trishna — felt no hunger or thirst; bhase ashru-jale — floats in tears

95Bathing at dawn, Dhruva repeats the mantra;
he feels neither hunger nor thirst — and is awash in tears.

পাঁচ সাত দিনে এক বদরি-ভক্ষণ ।
পক্ষান্তরে জলবিন্দু তুলসী-স্পর্শন ॥ ৯৬ ॥

pāṁca sāta dine eka badari-bhakṣaṇa |
pakṣāntare jalabindu tulasī-sparśana || 96 ||

pancha sata dine — once in five or seven days; eka badari-bhakshana — eating one badari berry; pakshantare — after a fortnight; jala-bindu — a drop of water; tulasi-sparshana — touched by tulasi

96Once in five or seven days he ate a single badari berry,
and after a fortnight — a drop of water touched by tulasi.

একান্ত ত্রিশ ত্রিশ কাল উপবাসে ।
পারণা আহার ধ্রুব করে একমাসে ॥ ৯৭ ॥

ekānta triśa triśa kāla upabāse |
pāraṇā āhāra dhruba kare ekamāse || 97 ||

ekanta — continuously; trisha trisha kala upavase — fasting thirty days at a time; parana ahara — the fast-breaking meal; dhruva kare eka-mase — Dhruva takes once a month

97Fasting thirty days at a stretch,
Dhruva broke his fast only once a month.2

ঊর্ধ্ববাহু করপুটে একপায়ে ভর ।
মন্ত্রজপ করে ধ্রুব দ্বাদশ-অক্ষর ॥ ৯৮ ॥

ūrdhbabāhu karapuṭe ekapāẏe bhara |
mantrajapa kare dhruba dbādaśa-akṣara || 98 ||

urdhva-bahu — arms raised; kara-pute — palms joined; eka-paye bhara — standing on one foot; mantra-japa kare dhruva — Dhruva repeats the mantra; dvadasha-akshara — of twelve syllables

98Arms raised, palms joined, standing on one foot,
Dhruva repeats the twelve-syllable mantra.

কালিন্দীর জলে ঊর্ধ্ব চরণযুগলে ।
গ্রীষ্মে তপ করে চারিদিগে অগ্নি জ্বলে ॥ ৯৯ ॥

kālindīra jale ūrdhba caraṇayugale |
grīṣme tapa kare cāridige agni jbale || 99 ||

kalindira jale — in the waters of the Kalindi; urdhva charana-yugale — with both feet upward; grishme tapa kare — in the hot season performs tapas; charidige agni jvale — with fire blazing on four sides

99[Standing] in the waters of the Kalindi, feet upward,3 [he practised austerity],
and in the hot season he performed tapas amid fires blazing on four sides.

শীতকালে কালিন্দীর জলে পড়ি' রহে ।
বর্ষাতে মঞ্চেতে — তাতে এত দুঃখ সহে ॥ ১০০ ॥

śītakāle kālindīra jale paṛi' rahe |
barṣāte mañcete — tāte eta duḥkha sahe || 100 ||

shita-kale — in winter; kalindira jale padi rahe — lies in the waters of the Kalindi; barshate manchete — in the rains on a platform; tate eta duhkha sahe — thus he endures so much hardship

100In winter he lies in the waters of the Kalindi,
in the rains on an open platform: so many hardships he endures.

ভাবিতে ভাবিতে ধ্রুবের লাগিল সমাধি ।
ত্রিভঙ্গ রহিল কৃষ্ণ-দর্শন অবধি ॥ ১০১ ॥

bhābite bhābite dhrubera lāgila samādhi |
tribhaṅga rahila kṛṣṇa-darśana abadhi || 101 ||

bhavite bhavite — meditating and meditating; dhruvera lagila samadhi — samadhi came upon Dhruva; tribhanga rahila — Tribhanga remained [in his meditation]; krishna-darshana avadhi — until the sight of Krishna

101Meditating and meditating, Dhruva entered samadhi:
the form of Tribhanga did not leave him until he saw Krishna.4

ইন্দ্র-আদি দেবগণে লাগে চমৎকার ।
না জানি এ কার পদ লবে অধিকার ॥ ১০২ ॥

indra-ādi debagaṇe lāge camatkāra |
nā jāni e kāra pada labe adhikāra || 102 ||

indra-adi devagane — Indra and the other gods; lage chamatkara — wonder seizes; na jani — we do not know; e kara pada labe adhikara — whose place he will take

102Indra and the other gods were seized with wonder:
"We do not know whose place he will take!"

ব্রহ্মা বোলে — পাছে লয় মোর অধিকার ।
ব্রহ্মপদ লবে ধ্রুব, জানি প্রতিকার ॥ ১০৩ ॥

brahmā bole — pāche laẏa mora adhikāra |
brahmapada labe dhruba, jāni pratikāra || 103 ||

brahma bole — Brahma says; pachhe laya mora adhikara — lest he take my place; brahma-pada labe dhruva — Dhruva will take Brahma's seat; jani pratikara — let us find a remedy

103Brahma says: "What if he takes my place?
Dhruva will take Brahma's seat — a remedy must be found."

কুবের বরুণ বোলে — মোর পদ লবে ।
কৃষ্ণ দিবেন ইহা জানি অনুভবে ॥ ১০৪ ॥

kubera baruṇa bole — mora pada labe |
kṛṣṇa dibena ihā jāni anubhabe || 104 ||

kuvera baruna bole — Kubera and Varuna say; mora pada labe — he will take my place; krishna dibena iha — Krishna will give it; jani anubhave — we know by intuition

104Kubera and Varuna say: "He will take my place:
Krishna will give it to him — we sense it."

ইন্দ্র বোলেন — ধ্রুব মোর পদ লবে ।
ততক্ষণে কৃষ্ণচন্দ্র কৃপা করি' দিবে ॥ ১০৫ ॥

indra bolena — dhruba mora pada labe |
tatakṣaṇe kṛṣṇacandra kṛpā kari' dibe || 105 ||

indra bolena — Indra says; dhruva mora pada labe — Dhruva will take my place; tatakshane — at once; krishnachandra kripa kari dibe — Krishnachandra will mercifully give [it]

105Indra says: "Dhruva will take my place —
Krishnachandra in His mercy will give it to him at once."

ইন্দ্র বোলে — মোর পদ সভার অভিলাষ ।
মোর পদ লবে ধ্রুব করিয়া উদাস ॥ ১০৬ ॥

indra bole — mora pada sabhāra abhilāṣa |
mora pada labe dhruba kariẏā udāsa || 106 ||

indra bole — Indra says; mora pada sabhara abhilasha — my place is everyone's desire; mora pada labe dhruva — Dhruva will take my place; kariya udasa — leaving [me] bereft

106Indra says: "My place is what everyone desires —
Dhruva will take it and leave me with nothing."

সর্বদেবগণে বোলে — উচ্চাসনে আমি ।
মোর পদ লবে ধ্রুব বড় পরিশ্রমী ॥ ১০৭ ॥

sarbadebagaṇe bole — uccāsane āmi |
mora pada labe dhruba baṛa pariśramī || 107 ||

sarva-devagane bole — all the gods say; uchchasane ami — I am on a high throne; mora pada labe dhruva — Dhruva will take my place; bada parishrami — the great toiler

107All the gods say: "I sit on a high throne;
Dhruva, the great ascetic, will take my place."

ধ্রুবের উৎকট তপ ভঙ্গ করিবারে ।
ব্রহ্মা-আদি দেবগণে নানা যুক্তি করে ॥ ১০৮ ॥

dhrubera utkaṭa tapa bhaṅga karibāre |
brahmā-ādi debagaṇe nānā yukti kare || 108 ||

dhruvera utkata tapa — Dhruva's fierce austerity; bhanga karibare — in order to break; brahma-adi devagane — Brahma and the other gods; nana yukti kare — devise various schemes

108To break Dhruva's fierce austerity,
Brahma and the other gods devise various schemes.

ত্রিভঙ্গে আছেন ধ্রুব একমন-চিত্তে ।
ইন্দ্র-আদি লঞা ব্রহ্মা গেলা পরীক্ষিতে ॥ ১০৯ ॥

tribhaṅge āchena dhruba ekamana-citte |
indra-ādi lañā brahmā gelā parīkṣite || 109 ||

tribhange achhena dhruva — Dhruva abides in Tribhanga; ekamana-chitte — with one-pointed mind; indra-adi lana — taking Indra and others; brahma gela parikshite — Brahma went to test

109Dhruva abides [in meditation on] Tribhanga with all his mind and heart;
Brahma, with Indra and the others, went to test him.

ধ্রুবের কর্ণমূলে কেহো ডাকে উচ্চ-রোলে —
মরিতে আইলে ধ্রুব মরিবার তরে ॥ ১১০ ॥

dhrubera karṇamūle keho ḍāke ucca-role —
marite āile dhruba maribāra tare || 110 ||

dhruvera karna-mule — right at Dhruva's ear; keho dake uchcha-role — someone shouts loudly; marite aile dhruva — you have come to die, Dhruva; maribara tare — to your death

110Right at Dhruva's ear someone shouts loudly:
"You have come here to your death, Dhruva!"

আর কেহো বোলে — ধ্রুব, মৈল তোর বাপ ।
কেহো বোলে — আরে ধ্রুব, যায় কালসাপ ॥ ১১১ ॥

āra keho bole — dhruba, maila tora bāpa |
keho bole — āre dhruba, yāẏa kālasāpa || 111 ||

ara keho bole — another says; dhruva, maila tora bapa — Dhruva, your father is dead; keho bole — someone says; are dhruva — hey, Dhruva; yaya kala-sapa — a black cobra goes [by]

111Another shouts: "Dhruva, your father is dead!"
Someone shouts: "Hey, Dhruva, a black cobra is coming!"

আর কেহ বোলে — ধ্রুব, মৈল তোর মা ।
কেহো বোলে — ধ্রুব, ঝাট পলাইয়া যা ॥ ১১২ ॥

āra keha bole — dhruba, maila tora mā |
keho bole — dhruba, jhāṭa palāiẏā yā || 112 ||

ara keha bole — another says; dhruva, maila tora ma — Dhruva, your mother is dead; keho bole — someone says; jhata palaiya ya — run away quickly

112Another shouts: "Dhruva, your mother is dead!"
Someone shouts: "Dhruva, run away quickly!"

আর কেহ বোলে — ধ্রুব, দাবাগ্নি আইল ।
কেহো বোলে — অহো, ধ্রুব মইল মইল ॥ ১১৩ ॥

āra keha bole — dhruba, dābāgni āila |
keho bole — aho, dhruba maila maila || 113 ||

ara keha bole — another says; dabagni aila — a forest fire has come; keho bole — someone says; aho, dhruva maila maila — ah, Dhruva is dead, dead

113Another shouts: "Dhruva, a forest fire is coming!"
Someone shouts: "Ah, Dhruva is dead, dead!"

ইন্দ্র হস্তী লঞা ধ্রুবের বুকে দিল দাঁত ।
শুণ্ডে বেড়াইয়া আনে ধ্রুবের জীভ ॥ ১১৪ ॥

indra hastī lañā dhrubera buke dila dāṁta |
śuṇḍe beṛāiẏā āne dhrubera jībha || 114 ||

indra hasti lana — Indra, bringing an elephant; dhruvera buke dila data — drove tusks into Dhruva's chest; shunde bedaiya — coiling with its trunk; ane dhruvera jibha — pulls Dhruva's tongue

114Indra brought an elephant, and it drove its tusks into Dhruva's chest;
coiling its trunk, it pulls at Dhruva's tongue.5

বায়ু অজাগর হঞা ধ্রুবেরে গিলিল ।
সূর্য ব্যাঘ্র-রূপ ধরি' ধ্রুব-রক্ত পিল ॥ ১১৫ ॥

bāẏu ajāgara hañā dhrubere gilila |
sūrya byāghra-rūpa dhari' dhruba-rakta pila || 115 ||

vayu ajagara hana — Vayu, becoming a python; dhruvere gilila — swallowed Dhruva; surya vyaghra-rupa dhari — Surya, taking a tiger's form; dhruva-rakta pila — drank Dhruva's blood

115Vayu, becoming a python, swallowed Dhruva;
Surya, taking the form of a tiger, drank Dhruva's blood.

নাগপাশে বান্ধি' ধ্রুবে অনলে ফেলিল ।
চন্দ্র ডুবাইল ধ্রুবে কালিন্দীর জলে ॥ ১১৬ ॥

nāgapāśe bāndhi' dhrube anale phelila |
candra ḍubāila dhrube kālindīra jale || 116 ||

naga-pashe bandhi — binding with a serpent-noose; dhruve anale phelila — threw Dhruva into fire; chandra dubaila dhruve — Chandra drowned Dhruva; kalindira jale — in the waters of the Kalindi

116Binding Dhruva with a serpent-noose, they threw him into fire;
Chandra drowned Dhruva in the waters of the Kalindi.

জিহ্বায় কৃষ্ণের নাম রটিল যাহার ।
কোটি-সর্পদংশনে কি করিবে তাহার ॥ ১১৭ ॥

jihbāẏa kṛṣṇera nāma raṭila yāhāra |
koṭi-sarpadaṃśane ki karibe tāhāra || 117 ||

jihvaya krishnera nama ratila yahara — on whose tongue Krishna's name resounds; koti-sarpa-damshane — the bites of millions of serpents; ki karibe tahara — what will they do to him

117He on whose tongue the name of Krishna resounds —
what can the bites of countless serpents do to him?

ত্রিভঙ্গ-ধেয়ান কেহ ভাঙ্গিতে নারিয়া ।
ব্রহ্মা-আদি দেবগণ গেল পলাইয়া ॥ ১১৮ ॥

tribhaṅga-dheẏāna keha bhāṅgite nāriẏā |
brahmā-ādi debagaṇa gela palāiẏā || 118 ||

tribhanga-dheyana — the meditation on Tribhanga; keha bhangite nariya — none being able to break; brahma-adi devagana — Brahma and the other gods; gela palaiya — fled

118Unable to break his meditation on Tribhanga,
Brahma and the other gods fled.

একমনে ভাবে ধ্রুব প্রভুর চরণ ।
আনন্দে গাইল গুণ এ দাস লোচন ॥ ১১৯ ॥

ekamane bhābe dhruba prabhura caraṇa |
ānande gāila guṇa e dāsa locana || 119 ||

ekamane bhave dhruva — with all his mind Dhruva meditates on; prabhura charana — the Lord's feet; anande gaila guna — joyfully sang the qualities; e dasa lochana — this servant Lochana

119With all his mind Dhruva meditates on the Lord's feet;
joyfully this Lochana Dasa sang of [His] qualities.

Raga — any; disha: "I have taken refuge at the crimson feet, O Gopala, merciful to the lowly."

তোমার নাম পতিতপাবন ।
জয় রে জয় রে জয় অধমতারণ ॥ ১২০ ॥

tomāra nāma patitapābana |
jaẏa re jaẏa re jaẏa adhamatāraṇa || 120 ||

tomara nama patita-pavana — Your name is Purifier of the fallen; jaya re jaya re jaya — glory, glory, glory; adhama-tarana — to the Deliverer of the lowly

120Your name is Purifier of the fallen;
glory, glory, glory to the Deliverer of the lowly!

আর অপরূপ কথা শুন সর্বজন ।
নারদ কৃষ্ণের কিছু কহিব বচন ॥ ১২১ ॥

āra aparūpa kathā śuna sarbajana |
nārada kṛṣṇera kichu kahiba bacana || 121 ||

ara aparupa katha — another wondrous tale; shuna sarvajana — listen, all; narada krishnera — of Narada to Krishna; kichhu kahiba bachana — some words I shall tell

121Listen, all, to another wondrous tale:
I shall tell what Narada said to Krishna.

বৈকুণ্ঠে কমলা-সনে রত্নসিংহাসনে ।
নারদের বীণাগীত শুনে তিনজনে ॥ ১২২ ॥

baikuṇṭhe kamalā-sane ratnasiṃhāsane |
nāradera bīṇāgīta śune tinajane || 122 ||

vaikunthe — in Vaikuntha; kamala-sane — with Kamala; ratna-simhasane — on a jewelled throne; naradera vina-gita — Narada's song to the vina; shune tinajane — three listen

122In Vaikuntha, on a jewelled throne, [Krishna] with Kamala —
the three listen to Narada's song to the vina.6

ঈষৎ হাসিয়া কৃষ্ণ নারদেরে কহে ।
আজি কেনে বীণাগীতে মন নাহি রহে ॥ ১২৩ ॥

īṣat hāsiẏā kṛṣṇa nāradere kahe |
āji kene bīṇāgīte mana nāhi rahe || 123 ||

ishat hasiya — smiling gently; krishna naradere kahe — Krishna says to Narada; aji kene — why today; vina-gite mana nahi rahe — the mind does not stay with the vina song

123With a gentle smile Krishna says to Narada:
"Why today is your mind not given to your song to the vina?"

নারদ বোলেন — শুন কমললোচন ।
যে কারণে বীণাগীতে নাহি রহে মন ॥ ১২৪ ॥

nārada bolena — śuna kamalalocana |
ye kāraṇe bīṇāgīte nāhi rahe mana || 124 ||

narada bolena — Narada says; shuna kamala-lochana — listen, Lotus-eyed One; ye karane — for what reason; vina-gite nahi rahe mana — the mind does not stay with the vina song

124Narada says: "Listen, Lotus-eyed One,
why my mind does not stay with my song to the vina:

তোমার ভকতে মোর হরি নিল মন ।
মনের দরিদ্র নাথ তুমি সর্বকাল ॥ ১২৫ ॥

tomāra bhakate mora hari nila mana |
manera daridra nātha tumi sarbakāla || 125 ||

tomara bhakate — Your devotee; mora hari nila mana — has stolen my mind; monera daridra natha — Lord of the poor in heart (?); tumi sarva-kala — You at all times

125Your devotee has stolen my mind. You, Lord, at all times are [the refuge] of those who have nothing [but You] in their hearts."7

নারদের বোল শুনি' কমললোচন ।
কহ মোরে কোন্ ভক্ত করেন স্মরণ ॥ ১২৬ ॥

nāradera bola śuni' kamalalocana |
kaha more kon bhakta karena smaraṇa || 126 ||

naradera bola shuni — hearing Narada's words; kamala-lochana — the Lotus-eyed One; kaha more — tell Me; kon bhakta karena smarana — which devotee remembers

126Hearing Narada's words, the Lotus-eyed One [says]:
"Tell Me, which devotee is remembering [Me]?"

উত্তানপাদের বেটা বড় মহামতি ।
স্বামিতে দুর্ভগা তার মাতা সুনীতি ॥ ১২৭ ॥

uttānapādera beṭā baṛa mahāmati |
sbāmite durbhagā tāra mātā sunīti || 127 ||

uttanapadera beta — the son of Uttanapada; bada mahamati — of great mind; svamite durbhaga — out of favour with her husband; tara mata suniti — his mother Suniti

127"The son of Uttanapada, [a boy] of great mind;
his mother Suniti is out of favour with her husband.

ধ্রুবের সতাই তার নাম সুরুচি ।
স্বামিসঙ্গে নানারঙ্গে সিংহাসনে বসি ॥ ১২৮ ॥

dhrubera satāi tāra nāma suruci |
sbāmisaṅge nānāraṅge siṃhāsane basi || 128 ||

dhruvera satai — Dhruva's stepmother; tara nama suruchi — her name is Suruchi; svami-sange — with her husband; nana-range — merrily; simhasane vasi — sitting on the throne

128Dhruva's stepmother is named Suruchi;
she sits merrily with her husband on the throne.

উত্তমাদি সাত ভাই মা-বাপের সঙ্গে ।
রত্নসিংহাসনে বসি' হাসে খেলে রঙ্গে ॥ ১২৯ ॥

uttamādi sāta bhāi mā-bāpera saṅge |
ratnasiṃhāsane basi' hāse khele raṅge || 129 ||

uttamadi sata bhai — the seven brothers beginning with Uttama; ma-bapera sange — with mother and father; ratna-simhasane vasi — sitting on the jewelled throne; hase khele range — laugh and play merrily

129The seven brothers, beginning with Uttama, with father and mother,
laugh and play merrily on the jewelled throne.

বাপের কোলে দেখিলেন ভাই সাতজনে ।
তা দেখিয়া উঠে ধ্রুব রত্নসিংহাসনে ॥ ১৩০ ॥

bāpera kole dekhilena bhāi sātajane |
tā dekhiẏā uṭhe dhruba ratnasiṃhāsane || 130 ||

bapera kole — on the father's lap; dekhilena bhai satajane — he saw the seven brothers; ta dekhiya — seeing that; uthe dhruva ratna-simhasane — Dhruva climbs the jewelled throne

130[Dhruva] saw the seven brothers on their father's lap —
and seeing this, Dhruva climbs onto the jewelled throne.

সিংহাসনে উঠিয়া বাপের কোলে যাইতে ।
ধ্রুবের সতাই ঠেলি' ফেলিল ভূমিতে ॥ ১৩১ ॥

siṃhāsane uṭhiẏā bāpera kole yāite |
dhrubera satāi ṭheli' phelila bhūmite || 131 ||

simhasane uthiya — climbing the throne; bapera kole yaite — to go onto the father's lap; dhruvera satai — Dhruva's stepmother; theli phelila bhumite — pushed him down to the ground

131When he climbed the throne to get onto his father's lap,
Dhruva's stepmother pushed him down to the ground.

ভূমিতে পড়িয়া ধ্রুব কান্দিতে লাগিল ।
স্ত্রীর বশ হঞা রাজা কিছু না বলিল ॥ ১৩২ ॥

bhūmite paṛiẏā dhruba kāndite lāgila |
strīra baśa hañā rājā kichu nā balila || 132 ||

bhumite padiya — falling to the ground; dhruva kandite lagila — Dhruva began to weep; strira vasha hana — being in his wife's power; raja kichhu na balila — the king said nothing

132Falling to the ground, Dhruva began to weep;
and the king, in his wife's power, said nothing.

সতাইর বোলে ধ্রুব পড়িল সঙ্কটে ।
মধুবনে তপ করে কালিন্দী-নিকটে ॥ ১৩৩ ॥

satāira bole dhruba paṛila saṅkaṭe |
madhubane tapa kare kālindī-nikaṭe || 133 ||

sataira bole — by the stepmother's words; dhruva padila sankate — Dhruva fell into distress; madhubane tapa kare — performs austerity in Madhuvana; kalindi-nikate — near the Kalindi

133By his stepmother's words Dhruva fell into distress —
and [now] he performs austerities in Madhuvana, near the Kalindi."

নারদের বোল শুনি' কমললোচন ।
ঈষৎ হাসিয়া বোলে মধুর বচন ॥ ১৩৪ ॥

nāradera bola śuni' kamalalocana |
īṣat hāsiẏā bole madhura bacana || 134 ||

naradera bola shuni — hearing Narada's words; kamala-lochana — the Lotus-eyed One; ishat hasiya — smiling gently; bole madhura bachana — speaks sweet words

134Hearing Narada's words, the Lotus-eyed One
with a gentle smile speaks sweet words:

অদীক্ষিত-জনে আমি কৃপা নাহি করি ।
অদীক্ষিত-জনের অপরাধ নাহি হরি ॥ ১৩৫ ॥

adīkṣita-jane āmi kṛpā nāhi kari |
adīkṣita-janera aparādha nāhi hari || 135 ||

adikshita-jane — to the uninitiated; ami kripa nahi kari — I do not show mercy; adikshita-janera — of the uninitiated; aparadha nahi hari — the offences I do not remove

135"To the uninitiated I do not show mercy:
the sins of the uninitiated I do not remove.8

আমারে ভাবিবে যেবা প্রতিজ্ঞা করিয়া ।
মধুবনে তপ করে মাতা পিতা ছাড়িয়া ॥ ১৩৬ ॥

āmāre bhābibe yebā pratijñā kariẏā |
madhubane tapa kare mātā pitā chāṛiẏā || 136 ||

amare bhavibe yeba — he who will meditate on Me; pratijna kariya — having vowed; madhubane tapa kare — performs austerity in Madhuvana; mata pita chhadiya — leaving mother and father

136[But he] who has vowed to meditate on Me
is performing austerities in Madhuvana, having left mother and father.

বৈষ্ণবীর গর্ভে কভু অবৈষ্ণব নহে ।
বৈষ্ণব বৈষ্ণবী হৈলে সব দুঃখ দহে ॥ ১৩৭ ॥

baiṣṇabīra garbhe kabhu abaiṣṇaba nahe |
baiṣṇaba baiṣṇabī haile saba duḥkha dahe || 137 ||

vaishnavira garbhe — from a Vaishnavi's womb; kabhu avaishnava nahe — never a non-Vaishnava; vaishnava vaishnavi haile — when [the son] is a Vaishnava and [the mother] a Vaishnavi; saba duhkha dahe — all sorrow burns away

137From a Vaishnavi's womb a non-Vaishnava is never born;
when [the son] is a Vaishnava and [the mother] a Vaishnavi, all sorrow burns away.

বৈষ্ণব-প্রতিজ্ঞা আমি অবশ্য করিব ।
যেই বর চাহে ধ্রুব সেই বর দিব ॥ ১৩৮ ॥

baiṣṇaba-pratijñā āmi abaśya kariba |
yei bara cāhe dhruba sei bara diba || 138 ||

vaishnava-pratijna — a Vaishnava's vow; ami avashya kariba — I shall surely fulfil; yei bara chahe dhruva — whatever boon Dhruva desires; sei bara diba — that boon I shall give

138The vow of a Vaishnava I shall surely fulfil:
whatever boon Dhruva desires, that boon I shall give.

প্রেমভক্তি-ডোরে বান্ধিয়াছে ভক্তজন ।
না পারি রহিতে ভক্ত করিলে স্মরণ ॥ ১৩৯ ॥

premabhakti-ḍore bāndhiẏāche bhaktajana |
nā pāri rahite bhakta karile smaraṇa || 139 ||

prema-bhakti-dore — with the rope of prema and bhakti; bandhiyachhe bhakta-jana — the devotees have bound [Me]; na pari rahite — I cannot stay; bhakta karile smarana — when a devotee remembers

139My devotees have bound Me with the rope of prema and bhakti:
when a devotee remembers [Me], I cannot stay [away]."

নারদ বোলেন — ধ্রুব অদীক্ষিত নহে ।
তুমি কৃপা কর গিয়া, দাবানলে দহে ॥ ১৪০ ॥

nārada bolena — dhruba adīkṣita nahe |
tumi kṛpā kara giẏā, dābānale dahe || 140 ||

narada bolena — Narada says; dhruva adikshita nahe — Dhruva is not uninitiated; tumi kripa kara giya — go and show mercy; dabanale dahe — he burns in a forest fire

140Narada says: "Dhruva is not without initiation;
go and show him mercy — he is burning as in a forest fire."

নারদের মুখে শুনি' কমললোচন ।
গরুড়ে চড়িয়া আইলা সেই মধুবন ॥ ১৪১ ॥

nāradera mukhe śuni' kamalalocana |
garuṛe caṛiẏā āilā sei madhubana || 141 ||

naradera mukhe shuni — hearing from Narada's lips; kamala-lochana — the Lotus-eyed One; garude chadiya — riding on Garuda; aila sei madhubana — came to that Madhuvana

141Hearing [this] from Narada's lips, the Lotus-eyed One
came, riding on Garuda, to that Madhuvana.

ধ্রুবেরে কহিল কৃষ্ণ ঈষৎ হাসিয়া ।
বর দিতে আইলাঙ তোমা' বৈকুণ্ঠ ছাড়িয়া ॥ ১৪২ ॥

dhrubere kahila kṛṣṇa īṣat hāsiẏā |
bara dite āilāṅa tomā' baikuṇṭha chāṛiẏā || 142 ||

dhruvere kahila krishna — Krishna said to Dhruva; ishat hasiya — smiling gently; bara dite ailanga toma — I have come to give you a boon; vaikuntha chhadiya — leaving Vaikuntha

142With a gentle smile Krishna said to Dhruva:
"I have left Vaikuntha and come to give you a boon."

শ্রীকৃষ্ণের আজ্ঞা শুনি' আনন্দ বাড়িল ।
ধ্যান ভাঙ্গি' জোড়হস্তে সম্মুখে রহিল ॥ ১৪৩ ॥

śrīkṛṣṇera ājñā śuni' ānanda bāṛila |
dhyāna bhāṅgi' joṛahaste sammukhe rahila || 143 ||

sri-krishnera ajna shuni — hearing Sri Krishna's word; ananda badila — joy grew; dhyana bhangi — breaking meditation; joda-haste sammukhe rahila — stood before [Him] with joined palms

143Hearing Sri Krishna's word, [Dhruva] was filled with joy;
coming out of meditation, he stood before Him with joined palms.

ধ্রুব বোলে — মহাপ্রভু, কি বর মাগিব ।
মোরে কৃপা কর — তোমার মহিমা বাড়িব ॥ ১৪৪ ॥

dhruba bole — mahāprabhu, ki bara māgiba |
more kṛpā kara — tomāra mahimā bāṛiba || 144 ||

dhruva bole — Dhruva says; mahaprabhu — great Lord; ki bara magiba — what boon shall I ask; more kripa kara — be merciful to me; tomara mahima badiba — Your glory will grow

144Dhruva says: "Great Lord, what boon shall I ask?
Be merciful to me — by that Your glory will grow."

প্রভু বোলে — তোমার কার্য অবশ্য করিব ।
যেই পদ চাহ তুমি সে-ই পদ দিব ॥ ১৪৫ ॥

prabhu bole — tomāra kārya abaśya kariba |
yei pada cāha tumi se-i pada diba || 145 ||

prabhu bole — the Lord says; tomara karya avashya kariba — your wish I shall surely fulfil; yei pada chaha tumi — whatever place you desire; sei pada diba — that place I shall give

145The Lord says: "Your wish I shall surely fulfil:
whatever place you desire, that place I shall give.

সম্প্রতি কহ কেনে আইলা মধুবনে ।
সতমাএ বসিতে না দিল সিংহাসনে ॥ ১৪৬ ॥

samprati kaha kene āilā madhubane |
satamāe basite nā dila siṃhāsane || 146 ||

samprati kaha — tell now; kene aila madhubane — why you came to Madhuvana; satamae — the stepmother; vasite na dila simhasane — did not let [you] sit on the throne

146Tell Me now, why have you come to Madhuvana?
[Is it because] your stepmother would not let you sit on the throne?

বড় উচ্চপদ যদি তোরে নাহি দিব ।
বাঞ্ছাকল্পতরু নাম কেমনে ধরিব ॥ ১৪৭ ॥

baṛa uccapada yadi tore nāhi diba |
bāñchākalpataru nāma kemane dhariba || 147 ||

bada uchcha-pada — the very highest place; yadi tore nahi diba — if I do not give you; vanchha-kalpataru nama — the name "wish-fulfilling Tree"; kemane dhariba — how shall I bear

147If I do not give you the very highest place,
how shall I bear the name 'Tree of Desires'?"

ধ্রুব বোলে — উচ্চপদ তৃণ হেন বাসি ।
তোমার ভক্তি নহিলে সব ভস্মরাশি ॥ ১৪৮ ॥

dhruba bole — uccapada tṛṇa hena bāsi |
tomāra bhakti nahile saba bhasmarāśi || 148 ||

dhruva bole — Dhruva says; uchcha-pada trina hena basi — I regard a high place as a straw; tomara bhakti nahile — without devotion to You; saba bhasma-rashi — all is a heap of ashes

148Dhruva says: "A high place I regard as a straw:
without devotion to You all is a heap of ashes."9

কৃষ্ণ বোলে — সব সিংহাসন দিব আমি ।
ত্রিজগতে উচ্চপদে থাক গিয়া তুমি ॥ ১৪৯ ॥

kṛṣṇa bole — saba siṃhāsana diba āmi |
trijagate uccapade thāka giẏā tumi || 149 ||

krishna bole — Krishna says; saba simhasana diba ami — I shall give [what is above] all thrones; trijagate uchcha-pade — in the highest place in the three worlds; thaka giya tumi — go and abide

149Krishna says: "I shall give you [what is above] all thrones:
go and abide in the highest place in the three worlds.

উত্তানপাদের বেটা, তুমি হবে রাজা ।
আমার মহিমা পাবে তোমার সব প্রজা ॥ ১৫০ ॥

uttānapādera beṭā, tumi habe rājā |
āmāra mahimā pābe tomāra saba prajā || 150 ||

uttanapadera beta — son of Uttanapada; tumi habe raja — you will be king; amara mahima pabe — will obtain My glory; tomara saba praja — all your subjects

150Son of Uttanapada, you will be king;
all your subjects will come to know My glory.

সভার উপরে ঋষি-বাসস্থান-মণ্ডল ।
ধ্রুবলোক বসে যেন — কহিল সকল ॥ ১৫১ ॥

sabhāra upare ṛṣi-bāsasthāna-maṇḍala |
dhrubaloka base yena — kahila sakala || 151 ||

sabhara upare — above all; rishi-vasasthana-mandala — the circle of the sages' abodes; dhruva-loka vase yena — how Dhruvaloka will stand; kahila sakala — He told everything

151Above all is the circle of the sages' abodes; [above it]
Dhruvaloka will stand" — so He told of everything.10

এই বর দিয়া কৃষ্ণ হৈলা অন্তর্ধান ।
বিশ্বকর্মা ধ্রুবলোক করিল নির্মাণ ॥ ১৫২ ॥

ei bara diẏā kṛṣṇa hailā antardhāna |
biśbakarmā dhrubaloka karila nirmāṇa || 152 ||

ei bara diya — giving this boon; krishna haila antardhana — Krishna disappeared; vishvakarma — Vishvakarma; dhruva-loka karila nirmana — built Dhruvaloka

152Having given this boon, Krishna disappeared,
and Vishvakarma built Dhruvaloka.

এই বর পাঞা ধ্রুব করিলা গমন ।
গোরাগুণ গায় সুখে এ দাস লোচন ॥ ১৫৩ ॥

ei bara pāñā dhruba karilā gamana |
gorāguṇa gāẏa sukhe e dāsa locana || 153 ||

ei bara pana — receiving this boon; dhruva karila gamana — Dhruva set out; gora-guna gaya sukhe — joyfully sings Gora's qualities; e dasa lochana — this servant Lochana

153Having received this boon, Dhruva set out;
joyfully this Lochana Dasa sings of Gora's qualities.

Raga — any; disha: "Come, O Gaura-Gopala, my life!"

কৃষ্ণ-আজ্ঞা শুনি' ধ্রুব দেশেরে চলিল ।
এথা সে উত্তানপাদের বৈরাগ্য বাড়িল ॥ ১৫৪ ॥

kṛṣṇa-ājñā śuni' dhruba deśere calila |
ethā se uttānapādera bairāgya bāṛila || 154 ||

krishna-ajna shuni — hearing Krishna's command; dhruva deshere chalila — Dhruva went to his land; etha se — and here; uttanapadera vairagya badila — Uttanapada's detachment grew

154Hearing Krishna's command, Dhruva set out for his homeland;
and here Uttanapada's detachment from the world grew.

ধ্রুবের সতাই কান্দে — ধ্রুব কোথা গেল ।
মুঞি অভাগিনী পুত্রে ঠেলিঞা ফেলিল ॥ ১৫৫ ॥

dhrubera satāi kānde — dhruba kothā gela |
muñi abhāginī putre ṭheliñā phelila || 155 ||

dhruvera satai kande — Dhruva's stepmother weeps; dhruva kotha gela — where has Dhruva gone; munni abhagini — I, wretched one; putre theliña phelila — pushed the son down

155Dhruva's stepmother weeps: "Where has Dhruva gone?
I, wretched one, pushed the son [off the throne]!"

রাজা বোলে — ছিল মোর পুত্রবধ লেখা ।
কতদিনে হবে আর ধ্রুব-সনে দেখা ॥ ১৫৬ ॥

rājā bole — chila mora putrabadha lekhā |
katadine habe āra dhruba-sane dekhā || 156 ||

raja bole — the king says; chhila mora putra-vadha lekha — it was written for me to destroy my son; katadine habe ara — when will there again be; dhruva-sane dekha — a meeting with Dhruva

156The king says: "It was my fate to destroy my son;
when shall I see Dhruva again?"

রাজা বোলে — ধ্রুবের মা, তুমি পাটরাণী ।
আজি হৈতে তোমার দাসী সকল সতিনী ॥ ১৫৭ ॥

rājā bole — dhrubera mā, tumi pāṭarāṇī |
āji haite tomāra dāsī sakala satinī || 157 ||

raja bole — the king says; dhruvera ma — mother of Dhruva; tumi pata-rani — you are the chief queen; aji haite — from today; tomara dasi sakala satini — all co-wives are your maidservants

157The king says: "Mother of Dhruva, you are the chief queen;
from today all your co-wives are your maidservants."

পুত্র না দেখিয়া রাজা বিস্মিত হইয়া ।
ভূমিতে পড়িয়া আছে মূরছিত হঞা ॥ ১৫৮ ॥

putra nā dekhiẏā rājā bismita haiẏā |
bhūmite paṛiẏā āche mūrachita hañā || 158 ||

putra na dekhiya — not seeing his son; raja vismita haiya — the king, distraught; bhumite padiya achhe — lies on the ground; murachhita hana — senseless

158Not seeing his son, the king, distraught,
lies senseless on the ground.

হেনকালে নারদ দেখিয়া আচম্বিত ।
উঠিলেন মহারাজ অন্তরে চিন্তিত ॥ ১৫৯ ॥

henakāle nārada dekhiẏā ācambita |
uṭhilena mahārāja antare cintita || 159 ||

henakale — at that time; narada dekhiya achambita — suddenly seeing Narada; uthilena maharaja — the maharaja rose; antare chintita — anxious at heart

159Suddenly he saw Narada —
the maharaja rose, anxious at heart.

পাদ্য অর্ঘ্য দিয়া দিল আসন বসিতে ।
আপন অন্তরকথা লাগিল কহিতে ॥ ১৬০ ॥

pādya arghya diẏā dila āsana basite |
āpana antarakathā lāgila kahite || 160 ||

padya arghya diya — offering water for the feet and arghya; dila asana vasite — gave a seat; apana antara-katha — what was in his heart; lagila kahite — began to tell

160Offering water for the feet and arghya, he gave [Narada] a seat
and began to tell him what was in his heart:

পাঁচবছরের এক বালক আমার ছিল ।
না জানিএ সে বালক কোথাকারে গেল ॥ ১৬১ ॥

pāṁcabacharera eka bālaka āmāra chila |
nā jānie se bālaka kothākāre gela || 161 ||

pancha-bachharera eka balaka — a five-year-old boy; amara chhila — I had; na janie — I do not know; se balaka kothakare gela — where that boy has gone

161"I had a five-year-old boy —
I do not know where that boy has gone."

নারদ বোলেন — ধ্রুবের অনেক সঙ্কট ।
কৃষ্ণভক্তি পাঞা আইল দেশের নিকট ॥ ১৬২ ॥

nārada bolena — dhrubera aneka saṅkaṭa |
kṛṣṇabhakti pāñā āila deśera nikaṭa || 162 ||

narada bolena — Narada says; dhruvera aneka sankata — Dhruva had many troubles; krishna-bhakti pana — gaining devotion to Krishna; aila deshera nikata — he has come near the land

162Narada says: "Many troubles befell Dhruva;
having gained devotion to Krishna, he has come near [your] land.

Thus [in the scriptures]:

কুলং পবিত্রং জননী কৃতার্থা
বসুন্ধরা বা বসতিশ্চ ধন্যা ।
স্বর্গে স্থিতাস্তৎপিতরোঽপি ধন্যা
যস্যাঃ সুতো বৈষ্ণবনাম লোকে ॥ ১৬৩ ॥

kulaṃ pabitraṃ jananī kṛtārthā
basundharā bā basatiśca dhanyā |
sbarge sthitāstatpitaro'pi dhanyā
yasyāḥ suto baiṣṇabanāma loke || 163 ||

kulam pavitram — the family is holy; janani kritartha — the mother has fulfilled her purpose; vasundhara va vasatih cha dhanya — blessed the earth and the dwelling; svarge sthitah tat-pitarah api dhanyah — blessed too her forefathers abiding in heaven; yasyah suto vaishnava-nama loke — whose son is known in the world as a Vaishnava

163Holy is the family, fulfilled is the mother, blessed is the earth and the place where she dwells, blessed too are her forefathers abiding in heaven — [that mother] whose son is known in the world as a Vaishnava.

যস্যাস্তি বৈষ্ণবঃ পুত্রঃ পুত্রিণী সা বিধীয়তে ।
অবৈষ্ণবশতপুত্রজননী শূকরীসমা ॥ ১৬৪ ॥

yasyāsti baiṣṇabaḥ putraḥ putriṇī sā bidhīẏate |
abaiṣṇabaśataputrajananī śūkarīsamā || 164 ||

yasya asti vaishnavah putrah — she who has a Vaishnava son; putrini sa vidhiyate — she is reckoned the mother of a son; avaishnava-shata-putra-janani — the mother of a hundred non-Vaishnava sons; shukari-sama — is like a sow

164She whose son is a Vaishnava is truly called the mother of a son; but the mother of a hundred non-Vaishnava sons is like a sow.11

যার বংশে বৈষ্ণব হএ একজনে ।
পিতৃ-মাতৃ-শ্বশুর-কুল উদ্ধারণে ॥ ১৬৫ ॥

yāra baṃśe baiṣṇaba hae ekajane |
pitṛ-mātṛ-śbaśura-kula uddhāraṇe || 165 ||

yara vamshe — in whose line; vaishnava hae ekajane — even one Vaishnava is born; pitri-matri-shvashura-kula — the families of father, mother and father-in-law; uddharane — he delivers

165In whose line even one Vaishnava is born,
[he] delivers the families of father, mother and father-in-law.

শ্রীকৃষ্ণ ভজি' আইল তোমার বালক ।
জানিহ সে বংশে তোমার ধ্রুব তিলক ॥ ১৬৬ ॥

śrīkṛṣṇa bhaji' āila tomāra bālaka |
jāniha se baṃśe tomāra dhruba tilaka || 166 ||

sri-krishna bhaji — having served Sri Krishna; aila tomara balaka — your boy has come; janiha — know; se vamshe tomara dhruva tilaka — Dhruva is the ornament of your line

166Your boy, having served Sri Krishna, is returning:
know that Dhruva is the ornament of your line."

নারদের বোলে রাজা হরিষ-মনোরথে ।
চুয়া-চন্দনের ছড়া দিল রাজপথে ॥ ১৬৭ ॥

nāradera bole rājā hariṣa-manorathe |
cuẏā-candanera chaṛā dila rājapathe || 167 ||

naradera bole — at Narada's words; raja harisha-manorathe — the king, filled with joy; chuya-chandanera chhada — a sprinkling of chuya and sandal; dila raja-pathe — made on the royal road

167At Narada's words the king, filled with joy,
sprinkled the royal road with chuya and sandal.

দধি, মঙ্গল দূর্বা, কুঙ্কুম, কস্তূরী ।
সূক্ষ্ম পুষ্প উজ্জ্বল, দীপ জ্বলে সারি সারি ॥ ১৬৮ ॥

dadhi, maṅgala dūrbā, kuṅkuma, kastūrī |
sūkṣma puṣpa ujjbala, dīpa jbale sāri sāri || 168 ||

dadhi — curd; mangala durva — auspicious durva grass; kunkuma — kunkuma; kasturi — musk; sukshma pushpa ujjvala — delicate bright flowers; dipa jvale sari sari — lamps burn in rows

168Curd, auspicious durva grass, kunkuma, musk,
delicate bright flowers; lamps burn in rows.

হারা-উদ্দেশে রাজা অনুব্রজ্যা ধায় ।
কথোদূরে গিয়া তবে ধ্রুবের লাগি পায় ॥ ১৬৯ ॥

hārā-uddeśe rājā anubrajyā dhāẏa |
kathodūre giẏā tabe dhrubera lāgi pāẏa || 169 ||

hara-uddeshe — in search of the lost one; raja anuvrajya dhaya — the king hastens to meet him; kathodure giya — going some distance; tabe dhruvera lagi paya — then he reaches Dhruva

169In search of his lost [son] the king hastens to meet him;
having gone some distance, he finds Dhruva.

ধ্রুবেরে দেখিঞা রাজা প্রাণ পাইল বোলে ।
লক্ষ লক্ষ চুম্ব দিয়া পুত্র কৈল কোলে ॥ ১৭০ ॥

dhrubere dekhiñā rājā prāṇa pāila bole |
lakṣa lakṣa cumba diẏā putra kaila kole || 170 ||

dhruvere dekhiña — seeing Dhruva; raja prana paila bole — the king as if gained life; laksha laksha chumba diya — giving countless kisses; putra kaila kole — took his son in his arms

170Seeing Dhruva, the king seemed to regain his life;
covering his son with countless kisses, he took him in his arms.

ধ্রুবেরে আনিঞা পুনঃ সভে কৈল রাজা ।
হাতে হাতে সমর্পিল পাত্র আর প্রজা ॥ ১৭১ ॥

dhrubere āniñā punaḥ sabhe kaila rājā |
hāte hāte samarpila pātra āra prajā || 171 ||

dhruvere aniña — bringing Dhruva; punah sabhe kaila raja — made him king before all; hate hate samarpila — handed over from hand to hand; patra ara praja — the ministers and subjects

171Bringing Dhruva back, he made him king before all
and from hand to hand gave over to him the ministers and subjects.

ধ্রুবেরে রাজ্য দিঞা রাজা গেল বনে ।
কথো দিন রাজ্য কৈল আনন্দিত মনে ॥ ১৭২ ॥

dhrubere rājya diñā rājā gela bane |
katho dina rājya kaila ānandita mane || 172 ||

dhruvere rajya diña — giving the kingdom to Dhruva; raja gela vane — the king went to the forest; katho dina rajya kaila — [Dhruva] ruled for a long time; anandita mane — with a joyful heart

172Giving the kingdom to Dhruva, the king went to the forest;
[and Dhruva] ruled for a long time with a joyful heart.

বলে দাপে নানাদেশ নিল একে একে ।
চল্লিশ বৎসর রাজ্য কৈল নিষ্কণ্টকে ॥ ১৭৩ ॥

bale dāpe nānādeśa nila eke eke |
calliśa batsara rājya kaila niṣkaṇṭake || 173 ||

bale dape — by might and power; nana-desha nila eke eke — took many lands one by one; challisha vatsara rajya kaila — ruled forty years; nishkantake — free of enemies

173By might and power he conquered many lands one after another
and ruled forty years free of enemies.12

দেব-গন্ধর্ব-মধ্যে নানা বিক্রম করি' ।
মাএ সঙ্গে লঞা ধ্রুব গেলা ধ্রুবপুরী ॥ ১৭৪ ॥

deba-gandharba-madhye nānā bikrama kari' |
māe saṅge lañā dhruba gelā dhrubapurī || 174 ||

deva-gandharva-madhye — among the gods and gandharvas; nana vikrama kari — showing much valour; mae sange lana — taking his mother along; dhruva gela dhruvapuri — Dhruva went to Dhruvapuri

174Having shown much valour among the gods and gandharvas,
Dhruva went with his mother to Dhruvapuri."

শচী বোলে — আমিহ যাইব তোমার সঙ্গে ।
থাকিব তোমার সঙ্গে কৃষ্ণকথা-রঙ্গে ॥ ১৭৫ ॥

śacī bole — āmiha yāiba tomāra saṅge |
thākiba tomāra saṅge kṛṣṇakathā-raṅge || 175 ||

shachi bole — Shachi says; amiha yaiba tomara sange — I too shall go with you; thakiba tomara sange — I shall stay with you; krishna-katha-range — in the joy of talks about Krishna

175Shachi says: "I too shall go with you,
I shall stay with you — in the joy of talks about Krishna.

তুমি হেন সোণার পুত্র যাবে মুড় মুড়ি' ।
মুঞি মুণ্ড মুড়াইয়া হইমু নাড়ী ॥ ১৭৬ ॥

tumi hena soṇāra putra yābe muṛa muṛi' |
muñi muṇḍa muṛāiẏā haimu nāṛī || 176 ||

tumi hena sonara putra — such a golden son as you; yabe muda mudi — will go with shaven head; munni munda mudaiya — I, shaving my head; haimu nadi — shall become shaven-headed

176If such a golden son as you goes away with a shaven head,
I too shall shave my head and become a shaven-headed woman.

রক্তবস্ত্র পরিব, কুণ্ডল দিমু কাণে ।
যোগিনী হইয়া আমি যাব তোমার সনে ॥ ১৭৭ ॥

raktabastra pariba, kuṇḍala dimu kāṇe |
yoginī haiẏā āmi yāba tomāra sane || 177 ||

rakta-vastra pariba — I shall wear red cloth; kundala dimu kane — put earrings in my ears; yogini haiya — becoming a yogini; ami yaba tomara sane — I shall go with you

177I shall put on red clothes, put kundala earrings in my ears,
become a yogini and go with you."13

মাএর বচনে প্রভু অস্তব্যস্ত হৈলা ।
কি দিব প্রবোধ বলি' চিন্তিতে লাগিলা ॥ ১৭৮ ॥

māera bacane prabhu astabyasta hailā |
ki diba prabodha bali' cintite lāgilā || 178 ||

maera bachane — at His mother's words; prabhu astavyasta haila — the Lord was at a loss; ki diba prabodha bali — saying, "What consolation shall I give?"; chintite lagila — began to think

178At His mother's words the Lord was at a loss
and began to think: "How shall I console her?"

সর্বজ্ঞ-শিরোমণি শচীর নন্দন ।
মাএরে প্রবোধ করে, এ দাস লোচন ॥ ১৭৯ ॥

sarbajña-śiromaṇi śacīra nandana |
māere prabodha kare, e dāsa locana || 179 ||

sarvajna-shiromani — the crest-jewel of the all-knowing; shachira nandana — Shachi's son; maere prabodha kare — consoles His mother; e dasa lochana — [sings] this servant Lochana

179The crest-jewel of the all-knowing, Shachi's son,
consoles His mother, [sings] this Lochana Dasa.

Raga varadi; disha: "This wondrous tale is called 'a blessing to the ear': listen to the song of Gora's qualities, Shachi's darling moon!"

অস্তব্যস্ত নহ — শুন আমার বচন ।
মিছা-কাজে দুঃখ চিত্তে কর কি কারণ ॥ ১৮০ ॥

astabyasta naha — śuna āmāra bacana |
michā-kāje duḥkha citte kara ki kāraṇa || 180 ||

astavyasta naha — do not be troubled; shuna amara bachana — listen to My words; michha-kaje — needlessly; duhkha chitte kara ki karana — why do you torment your heart with grief

180"Do not be troubled, listen to My words:
why do you needlessly torment your heart with grief?

বারে বারে কহি তোরে — নাহি অবধানে ।
মিছা কর লোভ, মোহ, ক্রোধ, অভিমানে ॥ ১৮১ ॥

bāre bāre kahi tore — nāhi abadhāne |
michā kara lobha, moha, krodha, abhimāne || 181 ||

bare bare kahi tore — again and again I tell you; nahi avadhane — [you] do not heed; michha kara — in vain you give yourself to; lobha, moha, krodha, abhimane — greed, delusion, anger, pride

181Again and again I tell you — and you do not heed:
in vain you [give yourself to] greed, delusion, anger and pride.

কে তুমি, তোমার পুত্র কে বা কার বাপ ।
মিছা 'তোর মোর' করি' কর অনুতাপ ॥ ১৮২ ॥

ke tumi, tomāra putra ke bā kāra bāpa |
michā 'tora mora' kari' kara anutāpa || 182 ||

ke tumi — who are you; tomara putra — [who is] your son; ke ba kara bapa — who is whose father; michha tora mora kari — vainly saying "yours, mine"; kara anutapa — you lament

182Who are you, who is your son, who is whose father?
In vain you lament, saying 'yours' and 'mine'.

কি নারী, পুরুষ আর কে বা কার পতি ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণচরণ বিনু আর নাহি গতি ॥ ১৮৩ ॥

ki nārī, puruṣa āra ke bā kāra pati |
śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇa binu āra nāhi gati || 183 ||

ki nari, purusha — what is woman, man; ara ke ba kara pati — and who is whose husband; sri-krishna-charana vinu — apart from Sri Krishna's feet; ara nahi gati — there is no other refuge

183What is woman, what is man, who is whose husband? —
apart from Sri Krishna's feet there is no other refuge.

সে-ই পিতা, সে-ই মাতা, সে-ই বন্ধুজন ।
সে-ই হর্তা, সে-ই কর্তা, সে-ই মাত্র ধন ॥ ১৮৪ ॥

se-i pitā, se-i mātā, se-i bandhujana |
se-i hartā, se-i kartā, se-i mātra dhana || 184 ||

sei pita — He is father; sei mata — He is mother; sei bandhu-jana — He is friend and kin; sei harta — He is the destroyer; sei karta — He the creator; sei matra dhana — He the only wealth

184He is father, He is mother, He is friend and kin;
He is the destroyer, He the creator, He the only wealth.

তা বিনু সকল মিছা — কহিল এ তত্ত্ব ।
তা বিনু সকল মিছা যতেক জগত ॥ ১৮৫ ॥

tā binu sakala michā — kahila e tattba |
tā binu sakala michā yateka jagata || 185 ||

ta vinu — without Him; sakala michha — all is empty; kahila e tattva — I have told this truth; ta vinu sakala michha — without Him all is empty; yateka jagata — whatever is in the world

185Without Him all is empty — this truth I have told you:
without Him empty is all there is in the world.14

বিষ্ণুমায়া-বন্ধে সব লোক সুযন্ত্রিত ।
নিজ মদ অহঙ্কারে কেবল পীড়িত ॥ ১৮৬ ॥

biṣṇumāẏā-bandhe saba loka suyantrita |
nija mada ahaṅkāre kebala pīṛita || 186 ||

vishnu-maya-bandhe — by the bonds of Vishnu's maya; saba loka suyantrita — all people are firmly bound; nija mada ahamkare — by their own intoxication and conceit; kevala pidita — they are only afflicted

186All people are firmly bound by the bonds of Vishnu's maya
and suffer only from their own intoxication and conceit.

নিজ ভাল ভাল বলি' যেই করে কর্ম ।
পরকালে বন্দী হয় সেই সব ধর্ম ॥ ১৮৭ ॥

nija bhāla bhāla bali' yei kare karma |
parakāle bandī haẏa sei saba dharma || 187 ||

nija bhala bhala bali — calling it "good for me"; yei kare karma — whatever deeds one does; parakale — in the hereafter; bandi haya sei saba dharma — those very dharmas become captivity

187Whatever deeds one does, thinking, 'This is good for me' —
those very dharmas hold one captive in the hereafter.

কর্মসূত্রে বন্দী হৈয়া বুলয়ে ভ্রমিয়া ।
আপনা না জানে মূঢ় কৃষ্ণ পাশরিয়া ॥ ১৮৮ ॥

karmasūtre bandī haiẏā bulaẏe bhramiẏā |
āpanā nā jāne mūṛha kṛṣṇa pāśariẏā || 188 ||

karma-sutre bandi haiya — captive on the thread of karma; bulaye bhramiya — he roams, wandering; apana na jane mudha — the fool does not know himself; krishna pashariya — forgetting Krishna

188Captive on the thread of karma, one wanders and roams;
the fool, forgetting Krishna, does not know himself.

চতুর্দশলোক-মধ্যে মনুষ্যের জন্ম ।
দুর্লভ করিয়া জানি — কহিল এ মর্ম ॥ ১৮৯ ॥

caturdaśaloka-madhye manuṣyera janma |
durlabha kariẏā jāni — kahila e marma || 189 ||

chaturdasha-loka-madhye — among the fourteen worlds; manushyera janma — human birth; durlabha kariya jani — is known as rare; kahila e marma — I have told this secret

189Among the fourteen worlds birth as a human being
is known to be rare — this secret I have revealed to you.

বিষয়-বিপাক ইথে আছয়ে অপার ।
ক্ষণেক-ভঙ্গুর এই অনিত্য সংসার ॥ ১৯০ ॥

biṣaẏa-bipāka ithe āchaẏe apāra |
kṣaṇeka-bhaṅgura ei anitya saṃsāra || 190 ||

vishaya-vipaka — the fruits of sense enjoyment; ithe achhaye apara — in this are boundless; kshaneka-bhangura — crumbling in a moment; ei anitya samsara — this transient samsara

190The fruits of sense enjoyment in this [world] are countless,
and this transient samsara itself crumbles in a moment.

তবু দুর্লভ জানি মনুষ্য-শরীর ।
কৃষ্ণ ভজয়ে যে মায়ায় হৈয়ে স্থির ॥ ১৯১ ॥

tabu durlabha jāni manuṣya-śarīra |
kṛṣṇa bhajaẏe ye māẏāẏa haiẏe sthira || 191 ||

tabu durlabha jani — yet known as rare; manushya-sharira — the human body; krishna bhajaye ye — [for one] who serves Krishna; mayaya haiye sthira — standing firm against maya

191And yet the human body is known to be rare
[for one] who serves Krishna, standing firm against maya.

শ্রীকৃষ্ণ-ভজন মাত্র এই সব দেহ ।
মুক্তবন্ধ হয় যদি কৃষ্ণে করে নেহ ॥ ১৯২ ॥

śrīkṛṣṇa-bhajana mātra ei saba deha |
muktabandha haẏa yadi kṛṣṇe kare neha || 192 ||

sri-krishna-bhajana matra — only for Sri Krishna's service; ei saba deha — all these bodies; mukta-bandha haya — is freed from bondage; yadi krishne kare neha — if one loves Krishna

192All these bodies are only for the service of Sri Krishna;
he is freed from bondage who loves Krishna.

পুত্রস্নেহে কর মোরে যত বড় ভাব ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণচরণে হৈলে কত হয় লাভ ॥ ১৯৩ ॥

putrasnehe kara more yata baṛa bhāba |
śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇe haile kata haẏa lābha || 193 ||

putra-snehe — with a son's affection; kara more — you have for Me; yata bada bhava — how great a feeling; sri-krishna-charane haile — if it were for Sri Krishna's feet; kata haya labha — how great would be the gain

193With what great tenderness you love Me as a son! —
if [that love] were given to Sri Krishna's feet, how great would be the gain!

সংসারে আরতি করে মরিবার তরে ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণে আরতি করে ভব তরিবারে ॥ ১৯৪ ॥

saṃsāre ārati kare maribāra tare |
śrīkṛṣṇe ārati kare bhaba taribāre || 194 ||

samsare arati kare — one is attached to samsara; maribara tare — [only] to die; sri-krishne arati kare — one is attached to Sri Krishna; bhava taribare — to cross [the ocean of] birth

194Attachment to samsara [leads only] to death,
but attachment to Sri Krishna — to crossing [the ocean of] birth.

সে-ই সে পরম বন্ধু, সে-ই মাতা-পিতা ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণচরণে যেই প্রেমভক্তি-দাতা ॥ ১৯৫ ॥

se-i se parama bandhu, se-i mātā-pitā |
śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇe yei premabhakti-dātā || 195 ||

sei se parama bandhu — he alone is the highest friend; sei mata-pita — he alone mother and father; sri-krishna-charane — for Sri Krishna's feet; yei prema-bhakti-data — who gives prema-bhakti

195He alone is the highest friend, he alone mother and father,
who gives prema-bhakti to Sri Krishna's feet.

কৃষ্ণের বিরহে মোর অন্তর কাতর ।
চরণে পড়িয়া বলি বিনয়-উত্তর ॥ ১৯৬ ॥

kṛṣṇera birahe mora antara kātara |
caraṇe paṛiẏā bali binaẏa-uttara || 196 ||

krishnera virahe — in separation from Krishna; mora antara katara — My heart is in anguish; charane padiya — falling at [your] feet; bali vinaya-uttara — I give a humble answer

196My heart is in anguish in separation from Krishna;
falling at your feet, I humbly answer you.

বিস্তর পীরিতি মোরে করিয়াছ তুমি ।
তোমার আজ্ঞায় শুদ্ধচিত্ত হই আমি ॥ ১৯৭ ॥

bistara pīriti more kariẏācha tumi |
tomāra ājñāẏa śuddhacitta hai āmi || 197 ||

vistara piriti — boundless love; more kariyachha tumi — you have shown Me; tomara ajnaya — by your command; shuddha-chitta hai ami — I become pure in heart

197You have given Me boundless love;
by your command I purify My heart.

আমার নিস্তার হয় তোর পরিত্রাণ ।
শ্রীকৃষ্ণচরণ ভজ — ছাড় পুত্রজ্ঞান ॥ ১৯৮ ॥

āmāra nistāra haẏa tora paritrāṇa |
śrīkṛṣṇacaraṇa bhaja — chāṛa putrajñāna || 198 ||

amara nistara haya — My deliverance is; tora paritrana — your salvation; sri-krishna-charana bhaja — serve Sri Krishna's feet; chhada putra-jnana — give up the thought "he is my son"

198My deliverance is your salvation too:
serve Sri Krishna's feet, give up the thought 'he is my son'.15

সন্ন্যাস করিব কৃষ্ণপ্রেমার কারণে ।
দেশে দেশে হৈতে আনি দিব প্রেমধনে ॥ ১৯৯ ॥

sannyāsa kariba kṛṣṇapremāra kāraṇe |
deśe deśe haite āni diba premadhane || 199 ||

sannyasa kariba — I shall take sannyasa; krishna-premara karane — for the sake of prema for Krishna; deshe deshe haite — from land after land; ani diba prema-dhane — I shall bring and give the wealth of prema

199I shall take sannyasa for the sake of prema for Krishna —
and from distant lands I shall bring and give you the wealth of prema.

আনের তনয় আনে রজত-সুবর্ণ ।
খাইলে বিনাশ পায় — নহে পরধর্ম ॥ ২০০ ॥

ānera tanaẏa āne rajata-subarṇa |
khāile bināśa pāẏa — nahe paradharma || 200 ||

anera tanaya — other people's sons; ane rajata-suvarna — bring silver and gold; khaile vinasha paya — when spent it perishes; nahe paradharma — it is not the highest dharma

200Other people's sons bring silver and gold:
spend it, and it is gone; this is not the highest dharma.

ধন-উপার্জন করি' আনে বড় দুঃখে ।
ধনই যাউক কিবা আপনি মরুক ॥ ২০১ ॥

dhana-upārjana kari' āne baṛa duḥkhe |
dhanai yāuka kibā āpani maruka || 201 ||

dhana-uparjana kari — earning wealth; ane bada duhkhe — they bring it with great hardship; dhanai yauka — either the wealth goes; kiba apani maruka — or he himself dies

201They earn wealth and bring it with great hardship —
and then either the wealth goes, or [the earner] himself dies.

আমি আনি দিব কৃষ্ণপ্রেম হেন ধন ।
সকল-সম্পদময় কৃষ্ণের চরণ ॥ ২০২ ॥

āmi āni diba kṛṣṇaprema hena dhana |
sakala-sampadamaẏa kṛṣṇera caraṇa || 202 ||

ami ani diba — I shall bring and give; krishna-prema hena dhana — such wealth as prema for Krishna; sakala-sampada-maya — full of all treasures; krishnera charana — are Krishna's feet

202But I shall bring you such wealth as prema for Krishna:
Krishna's feet are the sum of all treasures.

ইহলোকে পরলোকে অবিনাশী প্রেমা ।
আজ্ঞা দেহ বেদনী মা, চিত্তে দেহ ক্ষমা ॥ ২০৩ ॥

ihaloke paraloke abināśī premā |
ājñā deha bedanī mā, citte deha kṣamā || 203 ||

ihaloke paraloke — in this world and the next; avinashi prema — prema is imperishable; ajna deha — give leave; vedani (?) ma — mother; chitte deha kshama — calm [the grief] in your heart

203Prema is imperishable in this world and the next.
Give Me leave, mother, and calm [the grief] in your heart.16

সকল জনমে পিতা মাতা সভে পায় ।
কৃষ্ণ গুরু নাহি মিলে — বুঝিহ হিয়ায় ॥ ২০৪ ॥

sakala janame pitā mātā sabhe pāẏa |
kṛṣṇa guru nāhi mile — bujhiha hiẏāẏa || 204 ||

sakala janame — in every birth; pita mata sabhe paya — all obtain father and mother; krishna guru nahi mile — Krishna and the guru are not found; bujhiha hiyaya — understand in your heart

204Father and mother everyone obtains in every birth,
but Krishna and the guru are not obtained — understand this in your heart.

মনুষ্যজনমে কৃষ্ণ গুরু সভে জানি ।
যেই গুরু নাহি করে পশু পক্ষী মানি ॥ ২০৫ ॥

manuṣyajaname kṛṣṇa guru sabhe jāni |
yei guru nāhi kare paśu pakṣī māni || 205 ||

manushya-janame — in human birth; krishna guru sabhe jani — all can know Krishna and the guru; yei guru nahi kare — whoever does not accept a guru; pashu pakshi mani — I regard as beast or bird

205Only in human birth can all come to know Krishna and the guru;
one who does not accept a guru I regard as a beast or a bird."

ইহা শুনি' শচীদেবী বিস্মিত হিয়ায় ।
বিশ্বম্ভর-মুখপদ্ম একদৃষ্টে চায় ॥ ২০৬ ॥

ihā śuni' śacīdebī bismita hiẏāẏa |
biśbambhara-mukhapadma ekadṛṣṭe cāẏa || 206 ||

iha shuni — hearing this; shachi-devi vismita hiyaya — Shachi-devi, wonder-struck at heart; vishvambhara-mukha-padma — at Vishvambhara's lotus face; eka-drishte chaya — gazes unblinking

206Hearing this, Shachi-devi, wonder-struck at heart,
gazes unblinking at Vishvambhara's lotus face.

চতুর্দশলোকনাথ মায়া কৈল দূর ।
সর্বজীবে দেখে শচী এক সমতুল ॥ ২০৭ ॥

caturdaśalokanātha māẏā kaila dūra |
sarbajībe dekhe śacī eka samatula || 207 ||

chaturdasha-loka-natha — the Lord of the fourteen worlds; maya kaila dura — removed maya; sarva-jive dekhe shachi — Shachi sees all beings; eka samatula — as alike, equal

207The Lord of the fourteen worlds removed maya [from her]:
Shachi sees all beings as alike, equal.

সেইক্ষণে বিশ্বম্ভরে কৃষ্ণবুদ্ধি হৈল ।
'আপন তনয়' বলি' মায়া দূরে গেল ॥ ২০৮ ॥

seikṣaṇe biśbambhare kṛṣṇabuddhi haila |
'āpana tanaẏa' bali' māẏā dūre gela || 208 ||

sei-kshane — at that moment; vishvambhare krishna-buddhi haila — she perceived Krishna in Vishvambhara; apana tanaya bali — [the thought] "my own son"; maya dure gela — maya went away

208At that very moment she saw Krishna in Vishvambhara:
maya — [the thought] 'this is my son' — went away.17

নবমেঘ জিনি' দ্যুতি শ্যাম-কলেবর ।
ত্রিভঙ্গ, মুরলীধর, বর-পীতাম্বর ॥ ২০৯ ॥

nabamegha jini' dyuti śyāma-kalebara |
tribhaṅga, muralīdhara, bara-pītāmbara || 209 ||

nava-megha jini dyuti — with lustre surpassing a fresh cloud; shyama-kalevara — a dark body; tribhanga — thrice-bent; murali-dhara — holding the flute; bara-pitambara — in splendid yellow garments

209His body dark, outshining a fresh cloud,
thrice-bent, holding the flute, in splendid yellow garments —

গোপ, গোপী, গোপালের সনে বৃন্দাবনে ।
দেখিল আপন পুত্র চকিত তখনে ॥ ২১০ ॥

gopa, gopī, gopālera sane bṛndābane |
dekhila āpana putra cakita takhane || 210 ||

gopa, gopi, gopalera sane — with cowherds, gopis and cowherd boys; vrindavane — in Vrindavana; dekhila apana putra — she saw her own son; chakita takhane — amazed at that moment

210with cowherds, gopis and cowherd boys in Vrindavana
she then saw her own son — and stood amazed.

দেখি' শচী চমৎকার হইলা অন্তরে ।
পুলকে আকুল অঙ্গ, কম্প কলেবরে ॥ ২১১ ॥

dekhi' śacī camatkāra hailā antare |
pulake ākula aṅga, kampa kalebare || 211 ||

dekhi — seeing; shachi chamatkara haila antare — Shachi was astonished at heart; pulake akula anga — her body thrilled; kampa kalevare — trembling in her frame

211Seeing this, Shachi was astonished at heart;
her body thrilled, its hairs on end, her whole frame trembling.

স্নেহে নাহি ছাড়ে শচী আপন সম্বন্ধ ।
কৃষ্ণ হঞা পুত্র হৈলা ভাগ্যের নির্বন্ধ ॥ ২১২ ॥

snehe nāhi chāṛe śacī āpana sambandha |
kṛṣṇa hañā putra hailā bhāgyera nirbandha || 212 ||

snehe — in her tenderness; nahi chhade shachi — Shachi does not give up; apana sambandha — her own relation; krishna hana — being Krishna; putra haila — He became [my] son; bhagyera nirbandha — by fortune's decree

212[Yet] in her tenderness Shachi does not give up her own relation [to Him]:
"Krishna has become my son — so my good fortune has decreed.

জগত-দুর্লভ কৃষ্ণ আমার তনয় ।
কারু বশ নহে — মোর শক্ত্যে কিবা হয় ॥ ২১৩ ॥

jagata-durlabha kṛṣṇa āmāra tanaẏa |
kāru baśa nahe — mora śaktye kibā haẏa || 213 ||

jagata-durlabha krishna — Krishna, unattainable for the world; amara tanaya — is my son; karu vasha nahe — He is in no one's control; mora shaktye kiba haya — what can my strength do

213Krishna, unattainable for the world, is my son;
He is subject to no one's control — what can my strength do?"

এত অনুমানি' শচী কহিল বচন ।
স্বতন্ত্র ঈশ্বর তুমি পুরুষরতন ॥ ২১৪ ॥

eta anumāni' śacī kahila bacana |
sbatantra īśbara tumi puruṣaratana || 214 ||

eta anumani — reasoning thus; shachi kahila bachana — Shachi spoke; svatantra ishvara tumi — You are the independent Lord; purusha-ratana — the jewel among men

214Reasoning thus, Shachi spoke:
"You are the independent Lord, the jewel among men.

মোর ভাগ্যে এতদিন ছিলে মোর বশে ।
এখন আপন-সুখে করহ সন্ন্যাসে ॥ ২১৫ ॥

mora bhāgye etadina chile mora baśe |
ekhana āpana-sukhe karaha sannyāse || 215 ||

mora bhagye — by my good fortune; etadina chhile mora vashe — so long You were in my power; ekhana — now; apana-sukhe — as it pleases You; karaha sannyase — take sannyasa

215By my good fortune You were so long in my power —
now, as it pleases You, take sannyasa.

এক নিবেদন মোর আছে তোর ঠাঁই ।
এহেন সম্পদ মোর কি লাগিয়া যায় ॥ ২১৬ ॥

eka nibedana mora āche tora ṭhāṁi |
ehena sampada mora ki lāgiẏā yāẏa || 216 ||

eka nivedana mora — one request of mine; achhe tora thai — I have of You; ehena sampada mora — such a treasure of mine; ki lagiya yaya — why does it go away

216I have one request of You:
why is such a treasure of mine going away?"

ইহা বলি' সকরুণ ভেল কণ্ঠস্বর ।
সাত পাঁচ ধারা গলে নয়নের জল ॥ ২১৭ ॥

ihā bali' sakaruṇa bhela kaṇṭhasbara |
sāta pāṁca dhārā gale naẏanera jala || 217 ||

iha bali — saying this; sakaruna bhela kantha-svara — her voice became piteous; sata pancha dhara — in streams ("seven or five streams"); gale nayanera jala — tears flow from the eyes

217Saying this, she spoke in a piteous voice;
the tears streamed from her eyes.

ফুকরি' ফুকরি' কান্দে শচী সুচরিতা ।
মায়ের কান্দনে প্রভু হেঁট কৈল মাথা ॥ ২১৮ ॥

phukari' phukari' kānde śacī sucaritā |
māẏera kāndane prabhu heṁṭa kaila māthā || 218 ||

phukari phukari — sobbing and sobbing; kande shachi sucharita — virtuous Shachi weeps; mayera kandane — at the mother's weeping; prabhu henta kaila matha — the Lord bowed His head

218Sobbing and sobbing weeps virtuous Shachi;
at His mother's weeping the Lord bowed His head.

পুনরপি মুখ তুলি' কহে বিশ্বম্ভর ।
শুন গো জননী, তুমি আমার উত্তর ॥ ২১৯ ॥

punarapi mukha tuli' kahe biśbambhara |
śuna go jananī, tumi āmāra uttara || 219 ||

punarapi mukha tuli — raising His face again; kahe vishvambhara — Vishvambhara says; shuna go janani — listen, mother; tumi amara uttara — you, to My answer

219Then, raising His face again, Vishvambhara says:
"Listen, mother, to My answer:

যে দিন দেখিতে তুমি চাহ অনুরাগে ।
সেইক্ষণে আমা' তুমি দেখিবারে পাবে ॥ ২২০ ॥

ye dina dekhite tumi cāha anurāge |
seikṣaṇe āmā' tumi dekhibāre pābe || 220 ||

ye dina — on whatever day; dekhite tumi chaha anurage — you long with love to see; sei-kshane — at that moment; ama tumi dekhibare pabe — you will be able to see Me

220on any day when you long with love to see Me —
at that very moment you will be able to see Me."18

এ বোল শুনিঞা শচী সম্বরে ক্রন্দন ।
ব্যথিত-হৃদয়ে কহে এ দাস লোচন ॥ ২২১ ॥

e bola śuniñā śacī sambare krandana |
byathita-hṛdaẏe kahe e dāsa locana || 221 ||

e bola shuniña — hearing these words; shachi sambare krandana — Shachi restrains her weeping; vyathita-hridaye — with an aching heart; kahe e dasa lochana — says this servant Lochana

221Hearing these words, Shachi holds back her tears;
with an aching heart [this] was told by this Lochana Dasa.

✦

Notes

  1. The disha is corrupt in A (OCR: "হরিএ মহাশয় … ও-রাজ।চ্ণের অনেক মাতরী এলে নে জানিলুং") and is restored from the 1903 edition (C). Vv. 94–179 are absent from the 1983 edition (B), and in C they stand in the same footnote as the beginning of the story of Dhruva (see en/36, note 8): apparently a later insertion.
  2. Lit. "performs parana (the breaking of the fast) once a month". The line is corrupt in A, restored from C.
  3. So in A and C. Lochana Dasa's account of Dhruva's austerities does not follow the Bhagavata (4.8.71–76), where Dhruva gradually gives up fruits, leaves, water and finally breath, standing on one foot.
  4. Tribhanga ("thrice-bent") is Krishna of Vrindavana with the flute. In Lochana Dasa Dhruva meditates on this form, while the Lord comes to him from Vaikuntha on Garuda (vv. 141–142); in the Bhagavata Narada teaches Dhruva to meditate on the four-armed form (4.8.44–52). Lochana Dasa calls the Lord of Vaikuntha Krishna: Krishna is the source of all His manifestations.
  5. The tongue that repeats the mantra (cf. v. 117). The gods' trials are Lochana Dasa's detail; in the Bhagavata the gods only suffocate from Dhruva's austerity and beg the Lord for protection (4.8.80–82).
  6. Kamala is Lakshmi. The third listener is not named — apparently Bhu-devi, Narayana's other consort.
  7. The line is obscure ("মনের দরিদ্র নাথ তুমি সর্বকাল", lit. "of the poor in mind Lord You are at all times"); translated by the probable sense: the Lord is the treasure of the humble, who have nothing but Him.
